propositions: P6 vague lexicon matches word prefixes without trailing boundary, causing false positives (clean fires on cleanly/lint clean); fixed rule with word boundaries eliminates false positives
Two new blocking DET checks are implemented as separate entries rather than promotions inside P6: p10_verification_presence and p11_ac_vagueness
P10 blocks leaf plans without Testing/Verification H2 section AND without AC items containing backtick-fenced code or verification-vocabulary matches
P11 applies fixed lexicon with word boundaries to AC item lines only, exempting lexicon hits inside inline code spans and etc. occurrences within 30 characters after span ends
P6 remains advisory while P10 and P11 provide blocking enforcement; existing P6 test posture assertions are preserved
Documentation in docs/plan-review-gate.md deterministic-floor section is extended to describe P10 and P11 criteria
